params.body: Replaces #507 (same change; its CI failed on `SettingsPhoneLayoutTest`, which still asserted the old `Download` anchor; that assertion now reads the Alpine state and the full-width button). ## Why Clicking Download on Instellingen, Showroom gave `504 Gateway Time-out` in production (owner, 2026-09-16): PR 500 draws every slide in PHP inside the request, and with the photos coming from the bucket a few dozen slides run past the 60 s of the nginx proxy. The owner also asked for a spinner while the zip is prepared. ## What changed - **`App\Jobs\BuildShowroomZip`** (queue `default`): renders the slides with `ShowroomSlide`, zips them into `storage/app/showroom/{dealer}/showroom_fotos.zip` (private disk) and writes progress to the cache. In batches of 40 that chain into the next batch, so no job outlives the Forge worker's 328 s or the queue's `retry_after` of 400 s; the vehicle list is frozen at the first batch. A vehicle whose slide fails is skipped and named; when nothing can be drawn the build fails and leaves nothing behind (same two outcomes as before). - **`App\Support\ShowroomZip`**: state `showroom-zip:{dealer}` (`state` running|ready|failed, `done`, `total`, `skipped`, `path`, `size`, timestamps). A second start while running is ignored; a ready zip younger than 24 h is reused, older is rebuilt; a build without progress for 15 minutes reads as failed instead of spinning forever. - **Routes**: `POST settings/showroom/download/start` (`?again=1` rebuilds), `GET .../status` (JSON), `GET .../file` (404 until ready, then the zip). The old `GET settings/downloadshowroom` keeps its name, starts the build and lands on the tab, so bookmarks keep working. The state hangs on the logged-in dealer, so another dealer never reaches the zip. No `SmokeTest` change: all four paths contain `download` and stay out of its page lists. - **Tab** (Alpine, registered in the tab blade): Download; then "Bezig… 12 van 29 slides" with the existing `ui-spinner`, polling `/status` every 2 s; then "Downloaden (29 slides, 41 MB)" plus a quiet "Opnieuw maken" (`ui-link-btn`); a failure is a `ui.notify` and the button back. The first state comes with the page. Helper sentence now says the zip is built in the background and stays a day. New keys in `showroom.php` (nl/fr/en/de). - **Cleanup**: `stocklist:showroom-zip-prune`, hourly in `routes/console.php`, removes zips older than 24 h. Not in `stocklist:daily` because that command skips itself wherever `Outbound` is sealed. - Rule **S2-7.16** updated (queue, batches, progress, 24 h, old route). Outside production the queue is `sync` (the seal), so the click just takes long there; acceptable. ## Tests `ShowroomDownloadTest` rewritten (15 tests): job renders N vehicles with progress and a zip of N 1920x1080 jpegs; a showroom larger than one batch chains batches and holds every slide once; empty showroom is still an archive; one failing vehicle is skipped and named; all failing is `failed` with no archive; second start dispatches nothing; fresh zip reused, day-old zip rebuilt; sweeper removes old zips and keeps fresh ones; stale build reads as failed; start dispatches once and answers the state; status JSON shape (idle, running, ready); file 404 until ready and the zip once ready; another dealer gets 404; old route redirects to the tab and starts the build; tab renders idle/ready/running from the server state. `ScheduleTest` pins the hourly sweeper. Run: `ShowroomDownloadTest` (15, OK), `ShowroomSlideTest`, `ScheduleTest`, `AlpineExpressionTest`, `CompiledViewsTest`, `LanguageParityTest`, `RulesCoverageTest`, `RulesIdentityTest`, `StylesheetSyntaxTest`, `HandlerWiringTest`, `SettingsTabDeepLinkTest`, `IntegrationSmokeTest`, `RulesDocsBuildTest`: 69 tests OK (1 pre-existing incomplete). `SmokeTest`: 260/263, the 3 failures are `ownvehicle.edit` missing the uncommitted `public/js/vehicle/create.js` in the worktree, unrelated. ## Screenshots Idle, running ("Bezig… 12 van 29 slides"), ready ("Downloaden (2 slides, 185 kB)" + "Opnieuw maken") at 1440 and 390, verified on a local server with a real build and a real download of the zip (200, application/zip, `PK`). No hot shared files touched.
params.title: Showroom download runs in the queue with progress; no more gateway time-out (replaces #507)
